nodes.label: Lab batches
nodes.rationale: Implemented in revision 0012. Describes what exists; the original gap and the choices made are kept for context.

nodes.label: Lab batch gap
nodes.rationale: A practical is usually taught to part of a division. course_batches is an intake cohort, not a lab group, and timetable.course_batch_id and students.course_batch_id keep that meaning. Before 0012 no table said which students were in which lab group, so the attendance roster for a lab slot was the whole division and a teacher could mark a student from another batch.

nodes.label: lab_batch_groups
nodes.rationale: The batches a division is split into, per academic year and optional semester. A null division splits the whole class. A null semester means the same split all year. Batches are re-formed each year. MariaDB treats nulls as distinct in the unique key, so the service also checks for a same-named group before insert or rename. Inactive groups are left out of splits and generation. Capacity is respected by the generator and the member screen.

nodes.label: Dated lab batch membership
nodes.rationale: Memberships are dated rather than deleted, so a move from one batch to another keeps history. A student is current in at most one batch per split; set_members enforces that because one unique key cannot. Deleting a group sets timetable.lab_batch_group_id null and turns its slots back into whole-division slots. Attendance is never deleted. Existing rows need no migration because a null batch id stays a whole-division slot.

nodes.label: Lab batch roster rule
nodes.rationale: Start from the slot's course and class, narrow to its division, keep elective selections, then keep dated membership in the slot's batch. roster_clauses is the single SQL form, used by the mark screen, history, mobile sync and the mark endpoints. attendance_calc/roster.py applies the same rule in Python. A session before added_at or after ended_at is outside the roster. A saved mark is roster evidence, so marks taken before a move keep counting.

nodes.label: Lab batch clash rule
nodes.rationale: A whole-division slot clashes with everything in the division. Two slots of the same batch clash. Slots of different batches do not, so they can run practicals at the same time with different teachers and labs. Faculty and room clashes are unchanged: one person or room, one place. The generator expands each practical into one session per active batch and fills the other batches into the same slot.
